annotations.title: Is your service listable at all (free)

description: FREE and honest: does your own service publish a document a venue can read (/.well-known/x402, an agent card)? If it publishes none, no amount of submission work can list you anywhere, and you should not pay us until it does. At most three outbound GETs; we read the status of each document, never the body. Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST /feedback on this host -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

url.description: The absolute http(s) URL of YOUR service -- the one a venue should list. It must be publicly reachable: a loopback or private address is one no venue can verify.
